### Problem Statement

DuPont currently lacks a standardized mechanism to register, govern, and monitor internally developed and third-party AI agents operating across Microsoft and non-Microsoft platforms. While Agent 365 provides a centralized registry, governance controls, observability, and lifecycle management capabilities, agents developed outside native Microsoft environments cannot fully participate in these capabilities unless they are integrated through the Agent 365 SDK. As a result, the organization faces challenges with agent inventory accuracy, ownership accountability, governance consistency, security oversight, and visibility into agent usage, permissions, and risk exposure.

### Value Description

Implementing the Agent 365 SDK will enable DuPont to extend enterprise governance, security, and observability capabilities beyond native Microsoft agents to approved custom and third-party AI agents. By integrating agents into the Agent 365 ecosystem, DuPont can establish a centralized inventory, assign managed identities, improve ownership accountability, and apply consistent governance controls across a diverse agent landscape. The SDK provides a path for externally hosted agents to participate in Agent 365's registry, lifecycle management, security oversight, and monitoring capabilities rather than remaining unmanaged or only partially visible.

#### Desired Business Outcome

Utilizing the Agent 365 SDK will allow DuPont to validate and operationalize a consistent enterprise approach for agent registration, governance, security, and lifecycle management, helping ensure that AI agents deployed across the organization can be discovered, monitored, and managed through a unified control plane.
